variables.comment:
* Flag indicating that a document is virtual, and doesn't have byte * representation in the MIME type specified as {@link Document#COLUMN_MIME_TYPE}. * *

Virtual documents must have at least one alternative streamable * format via {@link DocumentsProvider#openTypedDocument} * * @see Document#FLAG_VIRTUAL_DOCUMENT
